about: The English names of things the UI, alerts, Home Assistant and the docs share (specs/026 DS-27). One name per thing: `keys` are the en.json strings that must say it (case aside: card titles are shown in capitals); `avoid` are other names for it that must not appear in UI text, the device's alert titles, or the docs; `parts` are part numbers, which name the hardware (System page, hardware docs) but never the thing in a card title or an alert; `ha` is the Home Assistant entity name (lib/HaDiscovery) that must match. Checked by tools/ui/label_check.py.
